1509960290607243267 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 41 🔁 4
So, i LIKE Alexander Technique, but, as with many things of the sort, i find it’s a-criticality distressing. It is treating “contracted awareness” but isn’t reflectively enough to ask why it arises in the fist place. In that it just adds loops and makes things *worse*.
↓
1509960292524040192 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 20
It’s like you press the gas pedal because the car is slow without questioning that maybe it’s slow because you’re also pressing the break. This is not good for the motor.
↓
1509960294067494912 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 14
The motor is you, and the one pressing the break is society.
↓
1509960295644598276 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 21
And this is the thing with all these modalities, there’s a modus ponens modus tollens inversion in which either you have a problem because you’re fucked or because society is and i claim it’s society and that in not addressing this they enable the gaslighting.
↓
1509960297292906505 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 22 🔁 1 [(SEED) type=semantic_search]
You don’t need to expand awareness - that’s it’s natural state - as much as you need to stop contracting it and *for that* you need to know why you’re contracting it in the first place.
↓
1509960300073988099 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 27 🔁 1
And MY THEORY is that it’s a survival theory learned early on. There’s many - many - subterranean things going on in society that only work insofar as people can’t perceive clearly or accurately. If they do *poof*
↓
1509960301780910088 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 14
But society kinda runs on these and so you get LOTS OF PRESSURE to “blind yourself” as it were.
↓
1509960303307542533 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 13 🔁 2
Ironically the “emperors new clothes” works as precisely this kind of thing while pretending to point at it - in reality people won’t join in, they’ll gaslit the shit out of the child and the few adults that chuckled too will be persecuted by everyone else.
↓
1509960308948938763 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 11
The concept of things being “above your station” “above your payroll” yea, that’s things you’re not supposed to look at
↓
1509960311243218946 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 8
And “false preference equilibria”, yea, that’s the kind of things being upheld by these incentive structures
↓
1509960313294278667 [2022-04-01] @nosilverv 💜 12
Now, of course that THIS ITSELF is horrible to look at, much better for your contracted awareness to be a quirky brain defect of yours you can fix with a few classes.
↓
